get.summary: REST: GET /v1/commands?node_id=. Newest first, at most 100.

REST: GET /v1/groups/{group_id}/replaySampling. Needs nodes:read; never
the key.

post.summary:
REST: POST /v1/groups/{group_id}:setReplaySampling. The share of
requests the group's nodes sample for replay, anonymized with the
group's key (W12-N-01); a new key when the group has none or
rotate_key is set. Above 0 only once the control plane runs with
-replay-sampling-approved (legal review of the sample format). Needs
replay:configure (admin).

delete.summary:
REST: DELETE /v1/nodes/{node_id}. The node's streams are cut and its
certificates refused from then on.

post.summary:
REST: POST /v1/nodes/{node_id}:collectDiagnostics. The agent answers
with non-sensitive facts (versions, bundle, counters). Needs nodes:write.

REST: POST /v1/nodes:clearForceShadow. Ends a force shadow before its
deadline: of policy_id, or every one of the nodes when it is empty
Same permission and audit.

REST: POST /v1/nodes:forceShadow. Emergency shadow mode for one policy
(or every policy) on one node or every node of a group, for a while
(nginx-module.md › Fallback). Needs policies:deploy; audited. Nodes
apply it within seconds while connected; a node that connects later
gets it if the duration has not run out.

parameters.name: template
parameters.description:
W20-S-01: start from this template (ListPolicyTemplates): its spec,
with the fields policy.spec sets on top. The policy records the
template's name and version, then is on its own: a later template
change does not reach it.

parameters.name: policy
parameters.description: id, spec, and the etag it was read with

name.description: Name in the bundle and in strata_policy: [a-z0-9._-]{1,55}.

approved_version.title:
the newest approved (or deployed) version, which a deploy builds, and
the newest deployed one; 0: none

schema.title: id, spec, and the etag it was read with

get.summary:
REST: GET /v1/policies/{policy_id}/versions; policy_id "-" with a state
lists that state across policies (the review queue: state=SUBMITTED).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: only versions in this state; "": all

get.summary:
REST: GET /v1/policies/{policy_id}/versions/{version}/replay. The
newest replay of the version, done or not; NOT_FOUND when there is none.

post.summary:
REST: POST /v1/policies/{policy_id}:approve. Approves a SUBMITTED
version; whoever drafted or submitted it may not (PERMISSION_DENIED).

REST: POST /v1/policies/{policy_id}:deploy. Builds a bundle of the
newest approved version of every policy, signs it and stores it in
object storage. Refused (FAILED_PRECONDITION) while the policy's newest
version is not approved.

REST: POST /v1/policies/{policy_id}:reject. Rejects a SUBMITTED
version, with a comment.

REST: POST /v1/policies/{policy_id}:replay. Queues the replay of a
version (0: the newest) against the bundle in force, on the policy's
traffic samples of the last 7 days and the corpus; follow it with
GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}.

REST: POST /v1/policies/{policy_id}:submit. Puts a DRAFT (or REJECTED)
version (0: the newest) up for review.

get.summary:
REST: GET /v1/policyTemplates. The templates a new policy can start
from (W20-S-01).

post.summary: REST: POST /v1/rollouts/{rollout_id}:abort. Nodes keep what they run.
REST: POST /v1/rollouts/{rollout_id}:pause. No new wave starts.

REST: POST /v1/rollouts/{rollout_id}:resume. Also after a failure,
once the cause is fixed.

REST: POST /v1/rules/{rule_id}:emergencyDisable. Emergency kill switch
(W12-G2-02): the rule stops matching, in every policy, on every node of
the group within seconds, without a deploy. It stays off (also for
nodes that connect later) until EnableRule. A reason is required;
operator and above (rules:disable); audited with the reason.

REST: POST /v1/rules/{rule_id}:enable. Switches the rule back on in
the group. Same permission, reason and audit.

get.summary:
REST: GET /v1/rules:disabled?group_id=. The rules switched off, of one
group or of every group. Needs nodes:read.

ttl_seconds.description: At most and by default 86400 (24 hours).

expected_replay_id.description:
Optional: the DONE replay report the reviewer inspected. A stale ID is
rejected atomically with the decision; omitted retains legacy behavior.

PolicySpecFailOnFindings.description:
#98: when the CPU budget runs out on a request that already has
findings (rules matched below the threshold), BLOCK answers as in fail
mode closed (503 with the Event ID) whatever the connector's fail mode;
PASS (and UNSPECIFIED) follows the fail mode. Enforce only. Modules
from before the setting refuse bundles that set BLOCK: upgrade first.

 - FAIL_ON_FINDINGS_UNSPECIFIED: pass

contents.title: policy id -> version built into the bundle

node_id.description: Exactly one of node_id and group_id.

policy_id.title: empty: every force shadow of the nodes

token.description: Shown once; only its SHA-256 is stored. Single use.

replay_operation.description:
The replay of the new version queued on its own; empty when replay is
not configured on this control plane.

rollout_id.description:
The rollout of the bundle to the nodes (GET /v1/rollouts/{id}); 0 when
this control plane does not distribute bundles.

commands.title: one per node of the group

node_id.description: Exactly one of node_id and group_id.

version.description: Control plane build version, e.g. 0.1.0 or a git describe string.

commit.description: Git commit the build came from; empty for local builds.

api_version.description: Admin API version in the path, "v1".

online.description: A stream is open, or a heartbeat came within the last 30 seconds.

kind.title:
FORCE_SHADOW, CLEAR_FORCE_SHADOW, DIAGNOSTICS, DISABLE_RULES,
SET_DISABLED_RULES, ENABLE_RULES

state.title:
PENDING (not sent yet), SENT, DONE, FAILED (the agent refused or
failed), EXPIRED (not answered before its deadline)

v1NodeCommand.description: NodeCommand is a command sent to one node and its result.

state.title: PENDING, RUNNING, DONE (replay set) or FAILED (error set)

name.description: Name in the bundle and in strata_policy: [a-z0-9._-]{1,55}.

approved_version.title:
the newest approved (or deployed) version, which a deploy builds, and
the newest deployed one; 0: none

id.description: exc- followed by 32 lowercase hex digits, unique within a policy.

expires_unix_ms.description: Absolute expiry in Unix milliseconds, mandatory and positive.

v1PolicyGeoRule.description:
A geo rule (W19-G2-01): an address in one of the countries or ASNs
matches; with not, an address outside all of them (local addresses
excepted). BLOCK blocks the request on the rule alone; LOG reports it
with an Event ID and never blocks.

max_snippet_size.description:
Longest input snippet of a match in the policy's events, in bytes:
0 or 128 (default), 2048 or 4096 (P-01 §1b). Modules from before the
setting refuse bundles with 2048 or 4096: upgrade them first.

privacy.description: Privacy settings on top of the built-in masks (P-01 §1).

canary_percent.description:
Enforce canary (W12-G2-01): share of clients, in percent (0.01 to 99.99,
two decimals), whose requests this enforce policy blocks; the others
run in shadow. 0: every client.

max_args.description:
Arguments inspected, query then body fields (#28): 1 to 1020, rounded up
to a multiple of 4; 0 = 1024. A request with more goes by `oversize`
(rule 100021). Modules from before the setting refuse bundles that set
it: upgrade them first.

exceptions.description:
Exact, expiring managed-rule field exclusions; at most 128 per policy.
Must follow the normal draft/replay/four-eyes/deploy flow. Old engines
refuse the required policy flag: upgrade them before using exceptions.

auto_staging.description:
Explicit delegation to reduce listed rules to log-only after FP evidence.
Default off; changes require replay and four-eyes approval. Never authorizes
automatic re-enforcement. Effective staged rule state is not an API input.

crs_paranoia.description:
W17-S-01: CRS paranoia level enforced, 1 to 4; 0 = 1. CRS rules up to
it block as usual.

crs_paranoia_shadow.description:
CRS paranoia level run in shadow, from crs_paranoia to 4; 0 = the
enforced level. Rules above the enforced level up to this one are
reported (Event ID, action log) but never block or add to the blocking
score. Modules from before the setting refuse bundles where either is
above 1: upgrade them first. A bundle with PL2 rules is larger (about
29 MB with the signature pack, above Vault transit's request limit).

crs_plugins.description:
W17-S-01: CRS plugins (rule exclusions for an application) the policy
runs, e.g. wordpress, nextcloud: on the application's known paths and
fields they take listed CRS rules or targets away. Each must have rules
in the deployed rule set (rules/crs-plugins). Modules from before the
setting refuse bundles with plugins: upgrade them first.

geo_rules.description:
W19-G2-01: the policy's own rules on the country and ASN of the client
address, run for this policy only; at most 16. Send id 0 for a new
rule: the control plane assigns a free id (190000-199999, unique across
policies). The deploy needs a GeoIP database (City for countries, ASN
for ASNs): the bundle carries the networks of the countries and ASNs
named. Modules from before the setting refuse bundles with them.

template.description:
W20-S-01: the template the policy started from, if any (set when the
policy is created from one; kept as it is by later versions).

v1PolicySpec.description:
PolicySpec is what the bundle carries for the policy
(docs/spec/policies.schema.json).

v1PolicyTemplateRef.description: The template a policy started from (W20-S-01); informative.

state.title: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED or DEPLOYED

decided_by.title: who approved or rejected it, when, and why

approved_replay_id.description: Completed replay bound by the approval, not a later unapproved replay.

sensitive_fields.description:
Field names whose input is never kept in events (parameters, headers,
the last part of a JSON path), case-insensitive; at most 64.

mask_patterns.description:
Patterns masked with '*' in event snippets and headers (linear-time
regex, not matching the empty string); at most 16, 256 bytes each.

identity.description:
plain (default) or hmac: events carry hmac: and 32 hex digits of
HMAC-SHA256 with the installation's identity key instead of the
identity (STRATA_IDENTITY_HMAC_KEY, or a key the control plane keeps).

newly_blocked.title:
blocked by the draft, not by the bundle in force: candidate false
positives; and the reverse: candidate false negatives

draft_actions.title: action -> samples, with the draft and with the bundle in force

newly_blocked_paths.title: route path (first two segments) -> newly blocked samples

newly_blocked_sampled.title:
the action recorded when the sample was taken (corpus: allow for
benign, block for attacks) -> samples

examples_blocked.title:
anonymized samples whose verdict changed (at most 5 each); only for
callers who may read input snippets (events:read_sensitive)

baseline_bundle.description: 0: no bundle was in force; the baseline was built from the policies.

truncated.title: there were more traffic samples than one replay takes

traffic.title: absent without traffic samples, and without a corpus

input_digest.description: SHA-256 of the prepared compiler inputs and exact compared artifacts.

v1ReplayReport.description:
What the draft changes against the bundle in force (engine/replay
compare, W12-R-01): on the policy's traffic samples of the last 7 days,
and on the benign and attack corpus, apart.

state.title: PENDING, NOTIFIED, DOWNLOADING, VERIFIED, ACTIVE, FAILED

rule_ids.description: 1–16 distinct existing managed Rule IDs; compiler/runtime verify membership.

window_seconds.description: Decision and initial report windows in seconds, 60–86400.

min_reports.description: Initial unambiguous FP reports, 1–min_matches; exact deployed bundle.

fp_threshold_bps.description: FP report share over matched security events, basis points, 1–10000.

v1RuleAutoStaging.description: Control-plane authorization metadata; not runtime policy parameters.
